name: Anke (Jiaxing) Smart Home Co., Ltd.
description: Founded in 2023 in Tianning Town, Jiaxing, producing outdoor garden furniture including tents and gazebos for Europe, America and the Middle East.

name: AXC Composites (Jiaxing) Co., Ltd.
description: Founded in 2006 in Huimin Subdistrict, AXC Composites manufactures non-metallic composite process pipes and equipment. It exports 80% of output (90% to Southeast Asia, the Middle East and Europe, 10% to the US), holds DVS 2212/2220 certification and is a National High-Tech Enterprise.

name: Bao Hsun Precision Screw (Zhejiang) Co., Ltd.
description: Bao Hsun Precision Screw manufactures construction hardware and high-strength automotive fasteners, including self-drilling, tapping and drywall screws, from an 8-hectare (120 mu) site with annual output of 30,000 tonnes.

name: Buffet Crampon (Jiashan) Co., Ltd.
description: Established in July 2019 as a wholly-owned subsidiary of Buffet Crampon SAS (France), the world's 2nd-largest wind instrument manufacturer, producing clarinets, saxophones and brass instruments.

name: Canaan Flooring Industries (China) Co., Ltd.
description: Founded in 2006 with USD73M capital and roughly 2,000 employees, Canaan Flooring is a National High-Tech Enterprise and one of China's largest laminate and SPC flooring exporters.

name: CAS Electronics (Zhejiang) Co., Ltd.
description: Founded in November 2009 as a wholly-owned Chinese subsidiary of South Korea's CAS Corporation, with a USD39.9M total investment. CAS is an established global manufacturer of industrial weighing equipment, retail scales and laboratory instruments, exporting to Japan, South Korea, India, the US and Europe.

name: Dacheng Travel Products (Jiaxing) Co., Ltd.
description: Established in 2023 in Dayun Town with 150+ employees, Dacheng Travel Products is a professional luggage manufacturer.

name: Gem-Year Industrial Co., Ltd.
description: Gem-Year Industrial, founded in November 1995 and headquartered in Jiashan, Zhejiang, is a Shanghai Stock Exchange-listed fastener manufacturer (SSE: 601002). Over 300,000 sqm of facilities produce 200,000+ tonnes a year of bolts, nuts, screws and special fasteners to GB/ANSI/DIN/ISO standards under ISO 9001 and ISO/TS16949, including high-speed railway fasteners with CRCC-grade certification.

name: Hengzhao Metal Products (Jiashan) Co., Ltd.
description: Operating in the Jiashan Economic & Technological Development Zone with USD16M capital and 111 employees, Hengzhao Metal Products is a 100% export-oriented subsidiary of Hengzhao Group (founded 1983), producing blind rivets, rivet nuts and hand tools under ISO 9001:2015.

name: Huisitong Medical Devices Co., Ltd.
description: Established in 2017 in Huimin Subdistrict with USD7.5M registered capital, Huisitong manufactures Class II/III medical devices, with 60% exported to Europe and 30% to the US. It holds ISO 9001/14001/45001/3834/13485 and CWB certification and was named a National High-Tech Enterprise in 2022.

name: Jiashan Agelai Electronic Technology Co., Ltd.
description: Founded in 2018, Agelai operates a 4,000 sqm factory producing self-service ordering machines and kiosks for export to the US, Europe, Japan and Latin America.

name: Jiashan Aixiang Metal Products Co., Ltd.
description: Established in 2009 in Yaozhuang Town with RMB4M capital, Aixiang Metal Products supplies hardware stamping parts for domestic sale and export.

name: Jiashan Aote Apparel Co., Ltd.
description: Established in February 2019 with RMB20M capital and 300 employees, Aote Apparel has monthly output of 150,000 pieces exported to Europe and America, and an active SHEIN storefront generating roughly RMB10M in annual online sales.

name: Jiashan Boyuan Home Textile Co., Ltd.
description: Founded in 2012 in Tianning Town, Jiashan County, Zhejiang, Boyuan is a household cleaning-product manufacturer with a 3,000 sqm facility and 100+ staff. It produces microfibre towels and cloths for automotive, kitchen, glass and living-room cleaning, holds ISO 9001 and BSCI certification, and exports mainly to Europe, Russia and the USA.

name: Jiashan Chaoyi Precision Hardware Co., Ltd.
description: Founded in 2005 in Yaozhuang Town, Chaoyi Precision Hardware makes fasteners. It is a National High-Tech Enterprise with ISO 9001:2015 certification.

name: Jiashan Chengqian Furniture Co., Ltd.
description: Founded in 2023 and based in Dayun Town, Jiashan, Chengqian is part of a Shanghai-headquartered furniture group whose brands include ARTDECO. It produces upholstered, solid wood and panel furniture with whole-home furnishing and large-project supporting services, is FSC CoC/FM certified, has capacity of 200+ containers a month, and exports across 16+ regions including Australia, North America, Europe and the Middle East.

name: Jiashan Chengyuan Furniture Co., Ltd.
description: A Shanghai-headquartered furniture group operating over 100,000 sqm of production space in Dayun Town, Jiashan, specialising in upholstered sofas and panel furniture for living, dining, bedroom and study collections under the ARTDECO and FULLCONCEPT brands. FSC CoC/FM certified, with production capacity exceeding 200 containers/month and exports to 100+ countries including Australia, the US, Japan, Germany and the Middle East.

name: Jiashan Chuantian Environmental Protection Technology Co., Ltd.
description: Founded in 2008 with USD1M capital, Chuantian Environmental Protection Technology is the main mainland China production base of Taiwan's Sanchuanhong, manufacturing electroplating filters and acid/alkali-resistant pumps under ISO 9001 and CE certification.

name: Jiashan Daye Coconut Home Technology Co., Ltd.
description: Founded in 2009 as a subsidiary of Daye Coconut Holding Group, Daye Coconut operates a '4.0 home furnishing' model and holds ISO 9001/14001 and OHSAS 18001 certifications.

name: Jiashan Dongrun Fasteners Co., Ltd.
description: Founded in 2006, Dongrun Fasteners manufactures fasteners to DIN/ANSI/GB standards, exporting to Europe, South America, North America, Russia and the Middle East.

name: Jiashan Falkenhausen Smart Home Co., Ltd.
description: Founded in 1991, Falkenhausen designs and produces sofas, with exports to 60+ countries.

name: Jiashan Fanxin Design Engineering Co., Ltd.
description: Established in 2015 in Tianning Town as a supporting production base for Shanghai Fanxin Exhibition Service, Fanxin produces display cabinets and holds ISO 9001/14001/45001 certifications.

name: Jiashan Feile Outdoor Products Co., Ltd.
description: Founded in 2014 in Luoxing Subdistrict with RMB36M registered capital, Feile manufactures leather goods and outdoor products exported mainly to the UK and US.

name: Jiashan Fengde Furniture Co., Ltd.
description: Founded in 2009 as a subsidiary of Fengsheng International Group in Ganyao Town, Jiashan, Fengde employs roughly 360 staff across a 37,541 sqm factory producing mid-to-high-end sofas for the US and Canada.

name: Jiashan Fuyide Plastic Co., Ltd.
description: Established in 2010 in Dayun Town with USD2.3M capital, Fuyide specialises in furniture-accessory R&D, precision mould design and injection moulding, exporting to the US, Canada and Australia. It holds IATF 16949, ISO 28000 and ISO 17712 certifications.

name: Jiashan Gesong Technology Development Co., Ltd.
description: Founded in 2019 with RMB1M capital, Gesong produces adhesives, sealants and car-care products exported mainly to Africa and South America, and holds ISO 9001/14001/45001 certifications.

name: Jiashan Haichuan Home Furnishing Co., Ltd.
description: Founded in 2008 in Huimin Town, Jiashan County, Haichuan produces sofas, reclining sofas, functional chairs, beds and pillows for export to Australia and South America.

name: Jiashan Haijie Plastic Co., Ltd.
description: Founded in 2005 in Dayun Town, Jiashan County, Haijie manufactures needle-punched nonwoven fabrics including automotive interior and wheel-cover felt, flame-retardant felt and air-filter materials, and holds ISO 9001:2008 certification. Its range also extends to geotextiles, garment and luggage lining and absorbent cotton.

name: Jiashan Hetai Hardware Tools Co., Ltd.
description: Established in 2006 in Ganyao Town with RMB28M registered capital, Hetai manufactures saw blades, bimetal hole saws and screwdriver bits for the US, UK, France, Germany and Russia, serving Kingfisher Group and cooperating with Stanley and TTI.

name: Jiashan Hongde Button Manufacturing Co., Ltd.
description: Founded in 2003, Hongde produces resin, metal, plastic, shell, coconut and wood buttons, with laser, electroplating and special-shaped processing capabilities.

name: Jiashan Huihui Metal Products Co., Ltd.
description: Founded in 2009 in Yaozhuang Town with around 120 employees, Huihui Metal Products manufactures A2/A4 stainless steel flat washers with annual output of 3,000 tonnes, exporting to Europe, South America, Southeast Asia and Oceania.

name: Jiashan Jilai Textile Co., Ltd.
description: A Tianning Town home textile manufacturer producing towels, bed linens, blankets and microfibre cleaning cloths for the USA, Europe, Japan, Australia and Southeast Asia. Jilai holds BSCI, ISO, OEKO-TEX, GRS and BRCGS certification, supplies Walmart and Carrefour, and has its own 'Gabeigim' brand.

name: Jiashan Kaixing Home Furnishing Co., Ltd.
description: Established in 2014 in Huimin Subdistrict, Jiashan, Kaixing produces household and commercial sofas for Australia, Europe and America.

name: Jiashan Lewa Furniture Co., Ltd.
description: Established in 2013 in Weitang Subdistrict, Jiashan, Lewa produces upholstered furniture and high-end custom mattresses with ergonomic sleep systems for the US, Australia and Canada.

name: Jiashan Lianyu Apparel Co., Ltd.
description: A Sino-foreign joint venture established in February 2004 in Ganyao Town's Industrial Development Zone, with 300+ employees and an 8,000 sqm factory. Lianyu specialises in mid-to-high-end down jackets, children's wear, down quilts and cushions and unlined spring-autumn apparel, with over 90% of output exported to North America, Europe and Asia.

name: Jiashan Meijie Cleaning Products Co., Ltd.
description: Established in March 2013 in Tianning Town, Jiashan County, Meijie is a microfibre fabric manufacturer whose output is 100% exported: roughly 50% to Europe, 10% to Japan and South Korea and 30% to Latin America.

name: Jiashan Qisheng Electronic Technology Co., Ltd.
description: Established in 2018 in Dayun Town, Qisheng produces high-end speakers, electronic products and auto parts for the US, South America and Europe, and has been a National High-Tech Enterprise since 2022.

name: Jiashan Ruijiao Apparel Accessories Factory
description: Founded in January 2013 in Xitang Town, Ruijiao produces buttons and apparel accessories as a stable supplier to local garment factories.

name: Jiashan Sangda Speaker Manufacturing Co., Ltd.
description: Founded in 2007 with RMB5M capital and 30+ employees, Sangda produces car audio, stage speakers, loudspeakers and electroacoustic accessories for export to the US, West Africa, Singapore and Canada.

name: Jiashan Sanying Lighting Co., Ltd.
description: Founded in 1996 in Guangdong and relocated to Jiashan in 2004, Sanying is a wholly foreign-owned manufacturer of energy-saving LED lighting sold mainly to the EU, certified to ISO 9001:2015 (BSI/CQC).

name: Jiashan Scheppach Tools Co., Ltd.
description: Jiashan Scheppach Tools was founded in 1997 in Huimin Subdistrict.

name: Jiashan Shanghong Commercial Equipment Co., Ltd.
description: Established in 2009 in Huimin Subdistrict with RMB10M capital, Shanghong Commercial Equipment manufactures supermarket shelving, automated storage shelving and intelligent vending machines, exporting to Europe and America under ISO 9001 and C-TPAT certification.

name: Jiashan Shengguang Electronics Co., Ltd.
description: Founded in 1993 in Dayun Town with 600+ employees, Shengguang Electronics is a leading bicycle lamp manufacturer producing lamps and horns for non-motor vehicles, exporting to Europe, the US and the Middle East with annual sales of roughly RMB250M.

name: Jiashan Shunyuan Home Textile Co., Ltd.
description: Founded in 2007, Shunyuan operates a 10,000 sqm facility in Jiaxing with 200+ staff and daily output of 300,000 pieces, producing microfibre cleaning towels, mop pads and auto and industrial cleaning cloths. It exports to the USA, Germany, Italy, Canada, Russia, France, Netherlands, Australia, Japan, Korea and India, and exhibits at the Canton Fair and Amsterdam Interclean Fair.

name: Jiashan Tongsheng Luggage Co., Ltd.
description: Founded in 2013 in Huimin Subdistrict, Tongsheng is a 100% export-oriented manufacturer of home storage products (70% Europe, 10% Japan, 20% Australia) holding BSCI, FSC and GRS certification.

name: Jiashan Weilong Health Care Equipment Co., Ltd.
description: A Sino-foreign joint venture founded in 1993 in the Jiashan Economic Development Zone, Weilong produces household massagers and fitness equipment under ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 13485:2022, with annual output value of RMB50-60M.

name: Jiashan Weiyue Fasteners Co., Ltd.
description: Founded in 2006 on Liuxi Road, Taozhuang Town, Jiashan, Weiyue produces seven washer types (plain, spring, gear, wave, square, lock and railway) in carbon steel, stainless steel, copper and aluminium by metal stamping, with annual output exceeding 5,000 tonnes.

name: Jiashan Xiangmu Luggage Co., Ltd.
description: Established in 2013 in Huimin Subdistrict, Xiangmu produces trolley cases, cosmetic cases, aluminium frame cases and cloth bags for the US, Singapore, Japan, South Korea, Europe and the Middle East, and cooperates with Disney, Metro and Pierre Cardin.

name: Jiashan Xiangyu Travel Products Co., Ltd.
description: A fully export-oriented suitcase manufacturer in Xitang Town, founded in 2014, with a 32,000 sqm facility and ISO 9001:2015 certification, shipping roughly 60% to Europe, 20% to the US and 20% to Southeast Asia.

name: Jiashan Xincheng Apparel Accessories Co., Ltd.
description: Located in Xitang Town, Xincheng produces buttons, apparel accessories, clothing products, zippers, woven tapes and hang tags.

name: Jiashan Xingtuo Apparel Accessories Co., Ltd.
description: Established in 1996 in Xitang Town, China's Hometown of Buttons, Xingtuo produces resin buttons, alloy buttons, rivet buttons and belt buckles, with a focus on diamond decorative and zinc alloy buttons.

name: Jiashan Xintian'e Down Products Co., Ltd.
description: Founded in 2000 in Huimin Subdistrict with RMB81M capital, Xintian'e is a high-quality down products manufacturer supplying brands including Uniqlo, Decathlon, GAP, NIKE and Hailan Home.

name: Jiashan Xuhui Display Technology Co., Ltd.
description: Based in Ganyao Town with 10+ years of experience, Xuhui produces plastic extruded profiles for supermarket shelving and retail display, exporting mainly to Eastern Europe and the Middle East.

name: Jiashan Yijianqing Pet Products Co., Ltd.
description: A Jiashan manufacturer of acrylic, wooden and loofah bird toys for parrots and small pets.

name: Jiashan Yinghe Fitness Equipment Co., Ltd.
description: A Sino-foreign joint venture founded in 2005 in the Jiashan Economic Development Zone, Yinghe produces household massagers and fitness equipment under ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 13485:2022, exporting to Europe, the US, Japan, Singapore, Hong Kong and Taiwan with annual output value of RMB400-500M.

name: Jiashan Yongxin Fasteners Co., Ltd.
description: Yongxin manufactures plain, flat, spring and big plain washers, and machine, drywall, self-tapping and self-drilling screws, in stainless steel, brass and other metals to ANSI/JIS/DIN/GB standards under ISO 9001:2000 certification. It exports to the US, Canada, the EU, Japan, the UK, Germany, Spain and Singapore.

name: Jiashan Yongyuan Home Textile Co., Ltd.
description: Founded in January 2014 in Tianning Town with RMB10M registered capital, Yongyuan is a home textiles and cleaning-products exporter making microfibre cloth and mop products. It holds BSCI certification and exports mainly to the US, Russia and Peru.

name: Jiashan Zhaoshi Apparel Accessories Co., Ltd.
description: Zhaoshi produces buttons and apparel accessories using Italian BONETTI & GUISSI button-making equipment, exporting to the US, EU, Japan and Southeast Asia.

name: Jiashan Zhida Electromechanical Co., Ltd.
description: Founded in 2002 on Huimin Street, Jiashan, Zhida manufactures auto and motorcycle repair tools including motorcycle lifts, shop presses and hydraulic equipment to CE/ASME/ANSI standards. A National High-Tech Enterprise and a leading domestic seller of motorcycle lifts, it exports 95% of output to America, Europe, Australia and Southeast Asia.

name: Jiaxin Jinshang Fashion Co., Ltd. (formerly Jiaxing Jinni Fashion)
description: Founded in 1997, Jinshang is a mid-to-high-end faux fur apparel producer with about 550,000 pieces of annual output, exporting to the EU, UK, US, Japan, South Korea and Russia.

name: Jiaxing Abigail Sporting Goods Co., Ltd.
description: Established in 2019 in Luoxing Subdistrict with RMB1.5M registered capital, Abigail produces outdoor and water sporting goods including inflatable surfboards and paddles, exporting to the US, Europe and Japan.

name: Jiaxing Aobai Sports Technology Co., Ltd.
description: Founded in 2018 in Weitang Subdistrict with USD6M registered capital, Aobai produces off-road leisure vehicles, hardware products, maternal and infant products, electric bicycles and outdoor products.

name: Jiaxing Baichuan Printing Technology Co., Ltd.
description: Established in July 2003 in Huimin Subdistrict, Baichuan produces inkjet inks, ink cartridges and digital printing consumables, exporting to Asia, Europe, Africa, the Americas and Australia. It holds SGS certification and its textile inks carry OEKO-TEX PASSPORT status.

name: Jiaxing Changbiwang Food Co., Ltd.
description: Founded in 2006 in Luoxing Subdistrict, Changbiwang produces puffed food and biscuits, and holds local "Large Taxpayer" and "Jiashan AAA Credit Enterprise" awards.

name: Jiaxing Edwin Home Products Co., Ltd.
description: Founded in 1989 in Huimin, Jiashan and trading today as Jiaxing Adwin Furniture Products Co., Ltd., Edwin is a two-generation family furniture maker producing upholstered sofas, coffee tables, custom furniture, wine cabinets, bookcases and beds. A National High-Tech Enterprise with a 45,800 sqm factory, it exports 80% of output to the Middle East, Asia-Pacific and Russia.

name: Jiaxing Haoneng Technology Co., Ltd.
description: Founded in January 1996 in Luoxing Subdistrict with RMB130M registered capital and 500+ employees, Haoneng is a leader in China's beer label industry, producing beer labels and beverage packaging for 200+ customers across 26 countries.

name: Jiaxing Haoyi Home Textile Co., Ltd.
description: Founded in June 2005 in Tianning Town, Haoyi is part of the Minda Group, with three production bases spanning weaving, dyeing and finishing. It holds Zhejiang Science and Technology Enterprise recognition and 247 appearance patents, producing home textiles (curtains, tablecloths, cushions) and garments including Han Chinese-style clothing.

name: Jiaxing Hexiong Apparel Co., Ltd.
description: Founded in 2004 in Shanghai and relocated to Xitang Town, Jiashan in 2014, Hexiong runs an 18,000 sqm facility producing zippers, buttons, hardware and silicone labels for apparel, bags and shoes.

name: Jiaxing Hongxin Can Manufacturing Co., Ltd.
description: Established in December 2015 in Dayun Town with USD16.5M registered capital, Hongxin manufactures tinplate boxes as an OEM supplier for food and tobacco packaging.

name: Jiaxing Huisen Medical Materials Technology Co., Ltd.
description: Founded in 2014, Huisen produces disposable medical hygiene materials, including scrub papers, paper-film composites, equipment covers, surgical drapes, bandages and pads, with 50+ staff including a PhD materials engineer.

name: Jiaxing Jianzhi Intelligent Electronics Co., Ltd.
description: Established in 2021, Jianzhi produces automotive lamp modules and offers customised services. It is IATF 16949 certified and has been a National High-Tech Enterprise since 2024.

name: Jiaxing Jiawei Sporting Goods Co., Ltd.
description: A professional manufacturer of sports equipment and table tennis tables sold worldwide.

name: Jiaxing Jieke Fashion Co., Ltd.
description: Founded in February 2009 in Taozhuang Town, Jieke produces organic cotton, linen and wool apparel sold mainly in Europe under own-brand and ODM models. It is GOTS, OCS and GRS certified and was named a Zhejiang Sci-Tech SME in 2020.

name: Jiaxing Jinbang New Materials Technology Co., Ltd.
description: Based in Taozhuang Industrial Park, Jinbang is a National High-Tech Enterprise producing engineering aluminium panels, aluminium ceiling tiles and decorative materials under ISO 9001:2015 certification.

name: Jiaxing Jufeng Garment Co., Ltd.
description: Founded in 2001 in the Jiashan Economic Development Zone, Jufeng produces suits, shirts, trousers, skirts and evening dresses in linen, rayon, silk and cotton.

name: Jiaxing Kaichen Precision Manufacturing Co., Ltd.
description: Established in 2023 in Taozhuang Town with RMB5M capital, Kaichen produces flange blanks, finished flanges and special-shaped parts, selling domestically and exporting to Vietnam and Myanmar.

name: Jiaxing Mingheng Health Technology Co., Ltd.
description: Founded in 2009 in the Jiashan Economic Development Zone with USD6.5M registered capital, Mingheng produces inflatable products such as paddle boards, rubber boats, fishing boats, lifeboats, rafting boats, floating platforms, gym mats and SPA pools. It holds TUV, BSCI, SEDEX and GMP certification and sells in the US, Europe and Japan.

name: Jiaxing Nanxi Knitting Needle Co., Ltd.
description: A Sino-South Korean joint venture trading as Jiaxing Namseo Knitting Needles Co., Ltd., with a factory on Xingye Road, Yaozhuang Town, Jiashan County. It makes knitting needle equipment and exports to Italy, Turkey, South Korea, Syria, India and Indonesia.

name: Jiaxing Qijia Import & Export Co., Ltd.
description: Founded in 2010, Qijia is a Jiaxing garment exporter (Xiuzhou District) with 25+ years of combined production experience across three subsidiaries and 10+ partner factories. It produces sweaters, knitwear, wovens, jeans and tencel garments almost entirely for export.

name: Jiaxing Qunyi Furniture Co., Ltd.
description: Established in 2013 in Tianning Town, Jiaxing, Qunyi operates dozens of branded retail stores across China and is an OEM producer for MD Sofa.

name: Jiaxing Ruibai Textile Interlining Co., Ltd.
description: Founded in 1995, Ruibai is one of China's earliest dual-dot process interlining manufacturers, with monthly production capacity of 6 million metres.

name: Jiaxing Ruiqing Leisure Sports Products Co., Ltd.
description: Established in 2014 in Dayun Town, Ruiqing produces sports equipment, amusement products, speakers, wooden crafts and plastic accessories, exporting mainly to the US, Canada and Mexico.

name: Jiaxing Shiyin Electronics Co., Ltd.
description: Established in April 2007 in Huimin Subdistrict with USD200,000 capital, Shiyin produces audio equipment, speakers, electronic musical instruments and microphones, and is the exclusive manufacturer of ORANGE brand guitar amplifiers (a UK brand founded in 1968).

name: Jiaxing TATA Wooden Door Manufacturing Co., Ltd.
description: Established in 2018 in Huimin Subdistrict, Jiashan with RMB100M investment and about 600 staff, this factory is part of TATA, a well-known Chinese wooden-door brand making paint-free and painted wooden doors.

name: Jiaxing Tuguan Car Safety Seat Co., Ltd.
description: A Sino-foreign joint venture established in 2015 with €8M investment, Tuguan manufactures child car safety seats, baby strollers, bicycle trailers and pet products, exporting to Europe, North America and Japan.

name: Jiaxing Xianling Toys Co., Ltd.
description: Established in 2016 in Luoxing Subdistrict, Xianling is a fully export-oriented children's toy manufacturer (80% Europe, 5% Japan, 5% US, 5% South America).

name: Jiaxing Xinfu Digital Technology Co., Ltd.
description: Founded in early 2015, Xinfu produces desktop digital printing paper with annual coating capacity of 40M+ square metres, and holds ISO 9001, FSC-CoC, SGS and OHSAS 18001 certification.

name: Jiaxing Xingcheng Electronics Co., Ltd.
description: Founded in 2002 with a 70,000 sqm factory and about 320 employees, Xingcheng Electronics produces electric vehicle lamps, bicycle lamps and horns, and wireless chargers, with annual output of 20M+ sets. Its products comply with ISO, GB, German STVZO, French, Japanese JIS and US FL lighting standards.

name: Jiaxing Xinyi Medical Equipment Co., Ltd.
description: Xinyi operates a 25,000 sqm facility with 120+ employees in the Jiaxing Economic Development Zone, manufacturing rollators, crutches, shower chairs, walking frames and other rehabilitation and mobility aids under ISO 13485 and CE certification. It exports to Europe, Asia and the Americas, with international clients including US distributor Medline.

name: Jiaxing Zhiyue Rubber & Plastic Co., Ltd.
description: Founded in 2013 in Huimin Subdistrict with RMB15.5M capital, Zhiyue produces rubber and plastic wheels and accessories exported to the US, Canada, Mexico, Argentina and Vietnam. It holds ISO 9001:2015 and Green Factory status, is RoHS/PAHs/REACH/CA Prop 65 compliant, and was recognised as a National High-Tech Enterprise in 2021.

name: Jinhua Juzhu Building Materials Co., Ltd.
Jufeng Smart Home Co., Ltd.
description: Founded in 2015 in Dayun Town, Jiashan, Jufeng produces smart sofas for export to the US, Australia and South America, and was recognised as a National High-Tech Enterprise in 2022.

name: Mengtian Home Furnishing Group Co., Ltd.
description: Mengtian Home Group is an A-share listed company (SSE: 603216) and a whole-home customisation woodworking manufacturer with 35 years of history. An aerospace-industry partner with 3,000+ employees, it runs intelligent production bases including Jiashan and Qingyuan.

name: Ripa Cosmetic Tools (Jiashan) Co., Ltd.
description: Founded in 2004 in Yaozhuang Town, Ripa produces cosmetic puffs, eye shadows and maternal and infant products, 100% exported to Japan, where it holds 50%+ market share. ISO 9001:2015 certified.

name: Saidun Medical Technology (Zhejiang) Co., Ltd.
description: Established in 2021 in Huimin Subdistrict with USD5M registered capital, Saidun manufactures IPL treatment devices under ISO 13485/14001/45001 certification, exporting to the US, Europe, Japan, Australia and Southeast Asia.

name: Shengji Home Products Development (Jiashan) Co., Ltd.
description: Established in 2018 as a foreign-invested enterprise with USD10M capital, Shengji produces outdoor leisure furniture, pavilions, heaters and grills for the US, Canada, Europe and Japan, and is a past recipient of Home Depot's 'Annual Quality Model' award.

name: Sinomax Zhejiang Polyurethane Technology Limited
description: Based in Weitang Subdistrict, Jiashan with USD52M capital and a roughly 210,000 sqm facility, Sinomax Zhejiang is an Asia-leading polyurethane foam manufacturer serving Europe, America, the Middle East and Japan. Its parent, the Sinomax Group, is a leading global manufacturer and distributor of visco-elastic (memory foam) products, with over 3,000 employees and top market share in the US, China and Hong Kong.

name: Smaide (Jiaxing) Medical Technology Co., Ltd.
description: Established in 2018 in Luoxing Subdistrict, Smaide is a B2B-only medical device design and OEM-parts specialist offering endoscope testing platforms and minimally invasive orthopaedic and gynaecological products under ISO 13485:2016 certification. It is a National High-Tech Enterprise.

name: SPEK Electronics (Jiashan) Co., Ltd.
description: A German-funded company founded in 1997, SPEK Electronics manufactures loudspeakers, subwoofers and woofers, home theatre and PA systems, amplifiers and voice coils, exporting primarily to the US and Europe. It has supplied major events such as the G20 Hangzhou Summit.

name: Stellar Group
description: Founded in 1995 in Shanghai, Stellar Group operates as Stellar Global and Stellar Furniture, with factories across Shanghai, Jiaxing (including its subsidiary Jiaxing Maixiong Furniture), Hong Kong and High Point, NC (USA). It produces Nordic-style modern leather upholstered sofas and office soft seating for over 105 countries.

name: Sunmi Intelligent Technology (Zhejiang) Co., Ltd.
description: Established in February 2024 in Weitang Subdistrict with RMB200M registered capital, Sunmi Zhejiang operates under the SUNMI brand, a leading 'BIoT for Business 4.0' hardware maker whose parent group (founded in 2013) is HKEX-listed (06810). SUNMI makes smart POS terminals, cash registers, self-checkout systems and IoT payment and kiosk devices, distributed in 200+ countries.

name: Suofeiya Home Furnishing (Zhejiang) Co., Ltd.
description: A wholly-owned Zhejiang subsidiary of the Suofeiya Home Furnishing group, with RMB595M capital, serving as the group's East China production base for custom cabinets, wardrobes and wooden doors.

name: UISEE Technology (Zhejiang) Co., Ltd.
description: UISEE is a full-stack L4 autonomous driving solutions provider founded in 2016, developing its U-Drive system for passenger, commercial, industrial and special-operation vehicles, with autonomous logistics and bus platforms such as the T05 series. It holds national 'little giant' innovation-enterprise status.

name: Wuhefu Children's Products (Jiashan) Co., Ltd.
description: A wholly foreign-owned enterprise founded in 2006 in Dayun Town with USD750,000 registered capital, Wuhefu manufactures baby cribs, strollers, toys, children's furniture and pet furniture, exporting mainly to the US and Europe.

name: Zhejiang Ampu Technology Co., Ltd.
description: Founded in 2000 in Weitang Subdistrict, Ampu manufactures printing consumables with 95% of output exported: roughly 50% to Europe, 20% to Asia, 15% to South America and 10% to North America.

name: Zhejiang ASD Living Electric Appliances Co., Ltd.
description: Founded in 2010 in Jiashan's Huimin Subdistrict, ASD Living is a small-appliance factory with 800+ staff making kitchen appliances (rice cookers, pressure cookers, induction cookers, kettles, blenders) for the US, Germany and France. It holds ISO 9001:2015 and BSCI certification and 332 patents.

name: Zhejiang Bachban Sanitary Ware Co., Ltd.
description: Established in 2010 in Huimin Subdistrict with USD5.1M capital, Bachban produces shower rooms, bathroom cabinets and shower accessories with French design input from its parent company, exporting mainly to France.

name: Zhejiang Bison Tools Co., Ltd.
description: Founded in 1995 in Ganyao Town, Jiashan, Zhejiang, Bison Tools operates a 65,000 sqm factory producing power tool accessories and hand tools that are 100% exported (50% Europe, 20% Japan, 30% US). It has accredited in-house testing and is a National High-Tech Enterprise.

name: Zhejiang Boxiang Nonwoven Technology Co., Ltd.
description: Founded in 2018 in Tianning Town, Boxiang manufactures spunlace nonwoven fabrics used in wet wipes, facial towels, masks and medical products such as surgical gowns and curtains.

name: Zhejiang Cangtian Intelligent Information Co., Ltd.
description: Founded in 2016 in Weitang Subdistrict, Cangtian makes computer peripherals, including laser printers, all-in-ones, scanners and barcode printers, with a top-5 domestic market share and growing overseas sales, mainly to Russia.

name: Zhejiang Dalton Carpet Co., Ltd.
description: Founded in 2008 in Weitang Industrial Park, Dalton produces commercial carpets (polypropylene and nylon modular) with annual output of roughly 1.6M sqm, over half of which is exported.

name: Zhejiang Dasheng Travel Products Co., Ltd.
description: Established in 2005, Dasheng is a comprehensive luggage manufacturer working in EVA, ABS and PC, producing trolley cases, laptop bags and handbags for customers including Samsonite, American Tourister and Disney. Monthly output is 80,000 hard cases plus 20,000 soft cases.

name: Zhejiang Dashun Kouduoduo Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd.
description: Established in December 2020 in Xitang Town as a joint venture between Cybernaut Investment Group and Zhejiang Dashun Resin Button, with annual capacity of 5 billion resin buttons.

name: Zhejiang Dingbang Furniture Co., Ltd.
description: Established in 2004 in Ganyao Town, Jiashan, Dingbang designs, develops and manufactures upholstered furniture, producing smart sofas for Europe and the US and specialty sofas for disabled children in Japan.

name: Zhejiang Dingyi Technology Development Co., Ltd.
description: Founded in 2017 with RMB30M capital, Dingyi is a National High-Tech Enterprise developing commercial-vehicle ADAS systems and leads the domestic L1-L3 ADAS market.

name: Zhejiang Fulei Smart Curtain Wall Co., Ltd.
description: Established in 2023 in Tianning Town, Fulei develops and produces doors and windows using German CNC equipment, with annual capacity of 300,000 sqm.

name: Zhejiang Gaoyu Home Technology Co., Ltd.
description: Founded in 2004, Gaoyu is a National High-Tech Enterprise producing polyurethane materials, memory foam mattresses, pillows and smart electric beds across 5 production bases including Vietnam, Myanmar and Canada, with 1,200+ employees exporting to the US, Europe and Japan.

name: Zhejiang Haiqi Technology Co., Ltd.
description: Founded in 2006 in Huimin Subdistrict, Haiqi produces faux fur and faux fur apparel, with 95% exported to Southeast Asia.

name: Zhejiang Hengke Industrial Co., Ltd.
description: Founded in 1995, Hengke is a leading manufacturer of computer speakers and portable audio with 10+ years of OEM/ODM experience, 20+ production lines and monthly capacity of 100,000 speakers plus 280,000 audio units.

name: Zhejiang Hong'an Paper Co., Ltd.
description: Established in 2001 in Yaozhuang Town with RMB150M capital, Hong'an Paper is a household-paper manufacturer whose KleenSoft brand holds 50%+ market share in the moisturising tissue category.

name: Zhejiang Hong'an Rigging Co., Ltd.
description: Founded in 1990, Hong'an Rigging supplies rigging products to major industrial clients including Sinopec, Wuhan Iron and Steel, and Sany Heavy Industry, exporting to Europe, the US and Japan.

name: Zhejiang Hongrun Decoration Materials Co., Ltd.
description: Hongrun is an integrated enterprise spanning raw-material procurement, processing, sales and installation for high-end residential, hotel, club, villa and office interior decoration, with clients such as Greentown, Greenland, Hilton and Marriott.

name: Zhejiang Huanshi Innovative Materials Co., Ltd.
description: Established in November 2010 in Weitang Subdistrict, Jiashan, Huanshi produces functional materials and exports mainly to the US, Japan and South Korea. It holds ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 certification and is a National High-Tech Enterprise.

name: Zhejiang Huizhong Garment Co., Ltd.
description: Based on Huimin Street, Jiashan, Huizhong is an OEM apparel manufacturer for international sports brands, including lululemon.

name: Zhejiang Husheng Nonwoven Co., Ltd.
description: Husheng manufactures spunlace nonwoven fabric from 30 to 150 GSM in viscose, polyester, bamboo, corn, Tencel and microfibre, for hygiene (wipes), medical (gowns, masks, dressings), automotive and filtration uses. It holds ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015 and FSC certification and was designated a National High-Tech Enterprise in 2021.

name: Zhejiang Jiafeng Electromechanical Co., Ltd.
description: Based in Weitang Town, Jiashan County, Jiafeng operates under the Hongfeng/Hontech Group as an OEM/ODM sheet-metal electromechanical solutions provider. It has over a decade of US shipments to clients including Key Tronic Corporation, and serves blue-chip finance, medical and telecom clients including Huawei, Philips and Brother.

name: Zhejiang Jiandi Hardware Manufacturing Co., Ltd.
description: Established in 2010 in Xitang Town with USD5M capital, Jiandi Hardware produces American and European-style locks with 30+ invention patents and capacity of 500,000 sets a year. It holds ISO 9001 and UL certification, is a National High-Tech Enterprise, and exports to Europe, America and the Middle East.

name: Zhejiang Jiangnan Outdoor Products Co., Ltd.
description: A 200+ employee manufacturer with a 20,000 sqm factory producing outdoor tents alongside archive storage, bank safe deposit boxes, vault equipment and supermarket and warehouse shelving.

name: Zhejiang Jiashan Yuanda Knitted Fur Co., Ltd.
description: A knitted fur fabric manufacturer running 128 circular knitting machines, with annual output of 10M+ metres.

name: Zhejiang Jinchun Precision Industry Co., Ltd.
description: Established in 2003 in Huimin Subdistrict with RMB158M capital, Jinchun Precision produces ground bars, nails and precision wires for the auto parts, medical device and fastener industries. It holds 5 invention patents and National High-Tech Enterprise status.

name: Zhejiang Jinhao Packaging Co., Ltd.
description: Based in Yaozhuang Town, Jinhao specialises in food paper laminating and printing, including bowl paper, lunch box paper and paper cup stock, with annual output of 20,000+ tonnes of paper plus 2 billion+ paper cups and boxes. It holds ISO 9001, ISO 14001, BRC, FSSC 22000 and FSC certification.

name: Zhejiang Jinji Auto Parts Co., Ltd.
description: A Sino-foreign joint venture founded in 2002 with USD75M total investment and 400+ employees, Jinji produces high-strength and special-shaped fasteners for the automotive, construction machinery and aerospace sectors. It holds 42 patents and National High-Tech Enterprise status.

name: Zhejiang Jinyuan Aluminum Foil Paper Co., Ltd.
description: Based in Weitang Subdistrict, Jinyuan produces sandwich aluminium foil paper, food aluminium foil paper, barbecue foil paper and candy wrapping paper, exporting mainly to the Middle East, Asia and North America.

name: Zhejiang Jiujing Refrigeration Equipment Co., Ltd.
description: Established in 2014 in Huimin Subdistrict with RMB50M capital, Jiujing Refrigeration Equipment produces ice makers, commercial refrigerators and display cabinets under the "HISAKAGE" brand, supplying Mixue, CoCo, KFC and Burger King. It holds ISO 9001, CE, CB and ETL certification and National High-Tech Enterprise status.

name: Zhejiang Jiushun New Materials Technology Co., Ltd.
description: Founded in 2013 in Tianning Town with RMB10M capital, Jiushun produces high-end dyed wood veneers and UV furniture boards for the US, Europe and Malaysia. It holds ISO 9001/14001 and OHSAS 18001 certifications and has been a National High-Tech Enterprise since 2017.

name: Zhejiang Jiuteng Packaging Materials Co., Ltd.
description: Founded in June 2010 in Huimin Subdistrict with RMB18M registered capital, Jiuteng manufactures POF heat shrink films, exports mainly to Europe and America, and is a National High-Tech Enterprise.

name: Zhejiang Kaman Rubber Flooring Co., Ltd.
description: Established in 2010 with RMB90M capital, Kaman is a National High-Tech Enterprise producing PVC coil and sheet flooring and wall panels, used in Beijing's Water Cube (2008 Olympics) and the Shanghai World Expo China Pavilion, and exported to 30+ countries.

name: Zhejiang Langsheng Food Co., Ltd.
description: Established in 2019 as a subsidiary of Guangxi Xuanma Food, Langsheng produces egg yolk crisps and baked snacks. Its "Xuanma Egg Yolk Crisp" ranks #1 in its category on Tmall.

name: Zhejiang Longsen Wood Industry Co., Ltd.
description: Based in Weitang Town, Jiashan with RMB100M+ capital, Longsen runs a 60,000 sqm wood flooring factory with 300+ employees using German and Italian equipment. It is ISO 9001/14001 certified, meets CARB quality standards and exports to the US, Canada and Japan.

name: Zhejiang Longyao Apparel Co., Ltd.
description: Established in January 2020 in Luoxing Subdistrict with RMB10M capital, Longyao produces fitness apparel and accessories exported to the US, Europe and Southeast Asia, and is OEKO-TEX 100 and GRS certified.

name: Zhejiang Lvneng Sports Industry Co., Ltd.
description: Founded in 2012, Lvneng manufactures EPDM coloured granules and polyurethane adhesives used in playgrounds, stadiums and walkways, exporting to the US, Canada, Australia, Japan and Europe.

name: Zhejiang Meijiada Stationery Co., Ltd.
description: Based in Ganyao Town, Meijiada produces mechanical pencils, ballpoint pens and gel pens under the "Metal Era" brand, with 6 direct sales offices across China, exports to Europe, Africa and Southeast Asia, and 40+ national patents.

name: Zhejiang Meisheng Intelligent Systems Co., Ltd.
description: Founded in 2007 in Yaozhuang Town with USD17M registered capital, Meisheng provides packaging and supply chain solutions, including hang tags, wash labels, barcode labels, colour boxes and RFID tags, with subsidiaries in 40+ countries and ISO 9001, ISO 14001, FSC-CoC and GRS certification.

name: Zhejiang Mingqi Display Technology Co., Ltd.
description: With 20+ years of history in Xitang Town, Mingqi runs a roughly 22,000 sqm factory producing commercial display furniture, including jewellery, retail, bakery and gondola display cabinets, with customised system solutions for Europe, America and the Middle East.

name: Zhejiang Paisen Smart Furniture Co., Ltd.
description: Based in Ganyao Town, Jiashan with RMB20M registered capital, Paisen produces upholstered and wooden furniture, apparel and foam products.

name: Zhejiang Panshi Electronics Co., Ltd.
description: Founded in August 2004 in Yaozhuang Subdistrict with USD5M capital, Panshi is an ISO 9001:2015 certified producer of professional audio and lighting equipment and an international trader, exporting mainly to the US.

name: Zhejiang Roushi Home Products Co., Ltd.
description: Established in 2007 in Huimin Subdistrict with RMB10M registered capital, Roushi manufactures suitcases, storage boxes and insulated bags under ISO 9001/14001/45001, exporting to the US, UK and Vietnam, and was named a National High-Tech Enterprise in 2021.

name: Zhejiang Sable Food Co., Ltd.
description: Founded in 2014 under Jiaxing Youxiang Food Co., Sable Food is known for its soft-filled cookies, winners of a Superior Taste Award from the International Taste Institute. Annual output of 1B+ pieces is exported to the Netherlands, Singapore, Malaysia, South Korea, Japan and Indonesia.

name: Zhejiang Sanming Electric Co., Ltd.
description: Founded in 1992 in Weitang Subdistrict with RMB26M registered capital, Sanming manufactures electric shavers, hair clippers, trimmers and dryers, skin care devices and curlers. It is BSCI and C-TPAT compliant, holds CB/CE/UL/CSA/CCC/PSE product certifications and exports to 20+ countries.

name: Zhejiang Sanying New Materials Co., Ltd.
description: Founded in 2007 with investment from Shanghai Chuangshi Medical Technology Group, Sanying New Materials produces super absorbent polymer (SAP) materials with annual output of 5,000 tonnes, exported mainly to Europe and Japan.

name: Zhejiang Shanxin Plastic Co., Ltd.
description: Founded in 2017 in Taozhuang Town with RMB20M capital, Shanxin produces plastic packaging barrels and tanks (5L to 1000L IBCs) with annual output of 2.5M barrels. It holds ISO 9001 plus dangerous-goods and food-production licences.

name: Zhejiang Shengwei Security Technology Co., Ltd.
description: Established in 2015 in Tianning Town with USD92M capital, Shengwei is one of China's largest security product manufacturers, producing safes, gun cabinets and vault equipment under the Safewell brand alongside data-centre products such as PDUs and cable management.

name: Zhejiang Tianhui Button Co., Ltd.
description: Established on 28 May 2007 in Xitang Town, China's "Hometown of Buttons", Tianhui has capacity of 400 million pieces a year across metal, resin, biodegradable and plastic buttons. It is certified to ISO 9001, ISO 14001, OHSAS 18001 and Oeko-Tex Standard 100, with clients including Moncler, Zara, Disney, Guess, Kiabi and PULL&BEAR, and is a global designated supplier for Terranova.

name: Zhejiang Tianmei Printing Materials Co., Ltd.
description: Located in Ganyao Industrial Zone, Jiashan, Tianmei (TNME) produces anodised hot stamping foil and vacuum and laser aluminised film on German coating lines, across a 30,000+ sqm facility with 200+ staff, exporting to 40+ countries.

name: Zhejiang Wanfu Metal Button Co., Ltd.
description: Founded in 1985, Wanfu is a long-established metal button manufacturer with 300+ automatic production lines, 100+ employees and 600+ cooperative customers.

name: Zhejiang Ximeng Technology Co., Ltd.
description: A Zhejiang plush-fabric group whose brand dates from 1985, Ximeng makes recycled, eco-friendly plush fabrics and partners with Target, Decathlon and Anta.

name: Zhejiang Yili Machinery Co., Ltd.
description: Based in Luoxing Subdistrict, Yili Machinery manufactures high-pressure washers, vacuum cleaners and cleaning tools under ISO 9001/14001, CE, GS, UL EMC, RoHS and BSCI certifications, exporting to 80+ countries including the US, Europe and Japan. In 2018 it accounted for roughly a third of global cleaner sales.

name: Zhejiang Yimi Optoelectronic Technology Co., Ltd.
description: A National High-Tech Enterprise producing LED and LD light source packaging across 20+ automatic production lines, selling to Europe and the US.

name: Zhejiang Yongdikang Technology Co., Ltd.
description: Founded in 2004 in Dayun Town with RMB20M capital and 225 employees, Yongdikang produces computer and laptop bags, cosmetic bags, trolley cases, refrigerated ice bags, travel bags, schoolbags and backpacks, with output of about 5M units a year for US and European markets.

name: Zhejiang Yongding Hardware Co., Ltd.
description: Founded in 2007 in Tianning Town, Yongding Hardware produces wire drawing and screw wire rod products sold entirely within China.

name: Zhejiang Yonghang Auto Parts Co., Ltd.
description: Founded in 2002 with USD9M capital and 260 employees, Yonghang is a hand-tool exporter producing screwdrivers, hex keys, bits and sockets for North America, Europe and Southeast Asia under VDE/GS certification, audited by Bosch, Snap-on and Home Depot.

name: Zhejiang Yuhua Home Materials Co., Ltd.
description: Founded in 1997 on Weitang Street, Jiashan, Yuhua operates roughly 200,000 sqm of modern facilities (7 substrate plants plus 1 finished-flooring plant) producing engineered wood flooring and solid wood whole-home furniture sold mainly to the US. It is ISO 9001/14001, FSC and CARB Phase 2 certified, and won anti-dumping cases against the US Commerce Department, securing double-zero duty status.

name: Zhejiang Zhenghua Paper Co., Ltd.
description: Founded in 2009, Zhenghua was China's first enterprise to independently develop moisturising tissues, under the "KleenSoft" brand, which ranks #1 on Tmall with 50%+ share. It holds patents for moisturising-liquid coating and facial-tissue folding equipment.

name: Zhejiang Zhongcheng Packaging Materials Co., Ltd.
description: Established in October 2001 in Huimin Subdistrict with RMB906M registered capital, Zhongcheng is a world-renowned POF heat shrink film manufacturer with 71,000 tonnes of annual capacity, sales to 60+ countries, and #1 domestic and #2 global market share.

name: Zhejiang Zhongyang Liku Technology Co., Ltd.
description: Founded in 2012 in Huimin Subdistrict with RMB50M capital, Zhongyang Liku Technology (part of Zhongyang Group) produces intelligent warehousing and logistics equipment, is TUV certified, and is a long-term partner of JD.com, Cainiao and Jingao Solar.

name: Zhejiang Zhuotai Printing Consumables Co., Ltd.
description: Founded on 6 June 2019 in Weitang Subdistrict with roughly 400 employees, Zhuotai refills toner cartridges, with annual capacity of approximately 30 million units and 90% of output exported to 80+ countries.
